cc:Work.dc:title: Random five-fold cross-validation
cc:Work.dc:description: Bolivia, 2017. Municipal SDG 1 No Poverty achievement index; higher is better. Nighttime lights: R² 0.553; Satellite embeddings: R² 0.691; Combined: R² 0.721. Values are quoted from published tables, not pooled prediction accuracy.
